task: Open “Soap opera” from keyboard focus or with Arrow Down and follow “La forza di una donna”. Confirm the public destination /soap/la-forza-di-una-donna/.
controlTask: Hover “Soap opera”, click “La forza di una donna” and confirm /soap/la-forza-di-una-donna/.
barrier: Keyboard focus reaches “Soap opera”, but after Arrow Down, Tab misses “La forza di una donna”. The closed submenu has display:none, and pointer hover applies the sfHover open class to its parent list item.
